title: Python essentials
outcome: Run small Python programs and explain how values flow through them.
topics: Install Python and inspect its version
exercises: Run python --version and print your interpreter path
Predict the types of 12 expressions, then check with type()
Ask for two numbers and print their sum
Compare /, // and % on positive and negative values
Produce a receipt with item, quantity and two-decimal total
Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit and test zero, negative and fractional inputs

title: Decisions and debugging
outcome: Express decision rules and diagnose failures.
exercises: Test equality and ordering for numbers and strings
Classify integers as even or odd; test zero, negative integers and positive values.
Write a truth table for a discount rule
Assign grades and test every boundary
Repair a NameError, TypeError, ValueError, indentation error and logic error
Validate age and prerequisites; write six expected outcomes before coding

title: Loops and strings
outcome: Automate repeated work without losing control of termination.
exercises: Print multiplication tables from 1 to 10
Read values until a sentinel and handle empty input
Reverse a string and extract alternating characters
Count vowels without calling count()
Print a coordinate grid and count loop iterations
Report words, characters and most frequent letter; test empty text

title: Functions and collections
outcome: Decompose a program into testable functions.
exercises: Write three functions with input/output examples
Explain why print is not return with a small experiment
Filter scores above a threshold without modifying the original
Store student names and marks with duplicate handling
Refactor a calculator into pure functions and an input loop
Add, update and summarize marks; test unknown students

title: Files and modules
outcome: Persist data and recover from expected failures.
exercises: Read a UTF-8 file with a context manager
Write and reload fields containing commas
Recover from missing files and invalid numbers
Round-trip nested expense records through JSON and verify types and values are preserved.
Extract validation and storage modules
Keep data across runs and test a corrupt input file

title: Objects, Git and tests
outcome: Maintain a small program with version control and automated tests.
exercises: Implement a BankAccount with a balance invariant
Build a cart containing independent item objects
Commit a working feature and inspect its diff
Create, merge and delete a feature branch locally
Test a valid case, boundary and exception
Publish a README with install, test and usage instructions

title: NumPy
outcome: Reason about shapes and vectorize numeric computations.
exercises: Create 1D and 2D arrays and inspect dtype and shape
Select rows using Boolean masks and verify the selected indices against a loop.
Predict valid operations for five shape pairs
Compute norms and dot products by hand and in NumPy
Time both versions on equal data and verify equality
Handle constant columns without dividing by zero

title: Data analysis and SQL
outcome: Turn messy tabular data into reproducible findings.
exercises: Load a public dataset and write a data dictionary
Record cleaning decisions and rows affected
Compare grouped means and medians and explain the effect of a single extreme outlier.
Use SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY and JOIN on small tables
Build three charts with units and readable axes
Reproduce findings from one script with citations

title: Linear algebra
outcome: Explain the geometry behind common ML operations.
exercises: Draw and normalize three vectors and verify that nonzero normalized vectors have unit length.
Apply scale and rotation to four points and plot original and transformed coordinates.
Compute cosine similarity including a zero-vector case
Verify dimensions before multiplying matrices
Solve a two-variable system by hand and check numerically
Fit an overdetermined system and inspect residuals

title: Calculus and searching
outcome: Connect gradients to optimization and analyze search costs.
exercises: Estimate a slope with finite differences
Differentiate a quadratic and verify at three points
Find the gradient of x squared plus 3y squared
Optimize a quadratic using three learning rates
Implement linear and binary search with edge-case tests
Plot loss trajectories and explain divergence

title: Probability and statistics
outcome: Quantify uncertainty without overstating evidence.
exercises: Compare mean and median with an outlier
Enumerate all 36 outcomes for two dice and calculate the probability of every possible sum.
Build a two-way table and calculate conditionals
Compute a diagnostic posterior using stated base rates
Simulate Bernoulli and normal samples
Compare empirical and theoretical probabilities

title: Sampling and foundations exam
outcome: Defend a complete data analysis with reproducible evidence.
exercises: Compare convenience and random samples
Resample means and plot their spread
Interpret an interval without claiming certainty about an individual
Solve three unseen problems and log mistakes
Combine CSV, SQL, statistics and charts in one repository
Present assumptions, tests and limitations; self-assess with the rubric

title: Machine learning foundations
outcome: Frame a prediction task and establish a baseline.
exercises: Describe a target available at prediction time
Compare regression and classification on three examples
Document licensing, collection and missing labels
Choose a metric tied to user impact and explain which harmful errors accuracy might hide.
Predict the mean or majority class and record performance
Specify splits, baseline, metric and likely failure cases

title: Linear regression
outcome: Implement and check gradient-based linear regression.
exercises: Plot predictions for three slopes on the same data and compare their squared residuals.
Compute MSE manually on four observations
Derive weight and bias gradients for mean squared error; check using finite differences.
Fit synthetic data without sklearn and recover a known slope within a stated tolerance.
Compare convergence with and without scaling
Match sklearn predictions within tolerance

title: Classification
outcome: Build and interpret a logistic classifier.
exercises: Plot sigmoid for positive and negative logits and explain saturation near its extremes.
Calculate log loss for confident wrong predictions
Fit a binary model on a public dataset
Compare confusion matrices at three thresholds
Compare accuracy with a majority baseline
Document threshold choice and error examples

title: Evaluation and leakage
outcome: Evaluate models without contaminating future estimates.
exercises: Create stratified splits with a fixed seed
Compute TP, FP, TN and FN by hand for ten predictions and verify the total sample count.
Explain errors in terms of a user need
Sweep thresholds using validation data only
Identify and remove post-outcome features
Keep test labels sealed until the final report

title: Trees and forests
outcome: Compare interpretable trees with ensemble methods.
exercises: Fit and plot a shallow decision tree
Compute Gini impurity for two candidate splits
Compare train and validation scores by depth
Sample with replacement and count unique rows
Compare a forest with a single tree on identical validation folds and record score variation.
Engineer two features inside the training pipeline

title: Boosting and tuning
outcome: Tune models with a defensible validation budget.
exercises: Explain how residual fitting changes predictions
Compare tree count and learning rate together
Run stratified folds and report score variance
Choose bounded ranges before inspecting results
Use randomized search with a fixed compute budget
Compare baseline, forest and boosting using identical folds

title: Unsupervised learning
outcome: Explore structure without treating clusters as truth.
exercises: Compare distances before and after standardization
Implement assignment and centroid update steps
Compare inertia across five random starts
Inspect silhouette scores and ambiguous points
Project data onto two principal components
Write what cluster labels do and do not imply

title: Reproducible pipelines
outcome: Ship a reproducible prediction pipeline.
exercises: Handle numeric and categorical columns separately
Fit imputation only on training folds
Combine transforms and estimator in a Pipeline
Reload a trusted artifact and compare outputs
Record dataset hash, seed and library versions
Reject invalid input and document model limitations

title: Neural networks
outcome: Explain a small network in terms of tensor operations.
exercises: Implement a threshold unit on two inputs
Compare ReLU, sigmoid and tanh outputs
Count parameters for a two-layer network
Compute a small forward pass by hand
Visualize a two-parameter loss slice
Fit a nonlinear toy dataset and compare a linear baseline

title: PyTorch and backpropagation
outcome: Use automatic differentiation and verify gradients.
exercises: Create tensors and verify shape transformations
Draw the graph of a composite function
Differentiate the graph by hand and verify each local derivative before applying the chain rule.
Compare autograd with finite differences
Batch a dataset without leaking validation labels
Zero gradients, backpropagate and update parameters

title: Training practice
outcome: Diagnose and improve neural network training.
exercises: Compare SGD and Adam with fixed initial weights
Separate train and eval modes correctly
Test dropout and weight decay independently
Plot train and validation loss per epoch
Save the best validation checkpoint and verify reloading it reproduces the validation predictions.
Record one hypothesis and change one factor per run

title: Vision and ML examination
outcome: Evaluate a transfer-learning model and defend its limits.
exercises: Calculate output shapes for three convolutions
Trace which input pixels affect an output
Freeze a pretrained backbone and fit a head
Apply augmentation to training images only
Inspect failures by class and image quality
Deploy the predictive system with tests, baseline and limitations

title: Language and embeddings
outcome: Represent text and inspect semantic behavior.
exercises: Compare normalization effects on names and punctuation
Count tokens for multilingual examples
Inspect out-of-vocabulary behavior on misspellings and unfamiliar names and record token sequences.
Compare sparse and dense representations
Rank five sentences by cosine similarity
Document provenance, licenses and harmful content handling

title: Transformers and inference
outcome: Explain attention and constrain generated outputs.
exercises: Calculate attention weights for a tiny matrix
Implement masked softmax attention and verify future positions have zero weight.
Compare order-sensitive and orderless representations
Annotate a block diagram with tensor shapes
Compare deterministic and sampled local-model outputs
Validate JSON against a schema and handle rejection

title: Semantic search
outcome: Build measurable nearest-neighbor retrieval.
exercises: Compare two local embedding models on ten queries
Test normalized cosine and dot-product equivalence
Index a small corpus with stable document IDs
Apply metadata filters before presenting results
Label relevant documents and calculate recall at k
Display matched passages with source URLs

title: Retrieval-augmented generation
outcome: Ground answers in inspectable retrieved evidence.
exercises: Extract text while retaining source and page IDs
Compare fixed and semantic chunks on the same corpus
Retrieve top-k passages with scores and stable source IDs and inspect five labeled queries.
Keep instructions separate from untrusted documents
Return citations and abstain when evidence is missing
Measure retrieval recall and manually judge grounded answers

title: Tools and function calls
outcome: Validate and execute narrowly scoped tool requests.
exercises: Specify inputs, outputs and side effects for a tool
Write a schema rejecting unknown properties
Reject malformed and out-of-range arguments
Require confirmation before an external mutation
Handle timeout, permission denial and partial failure
Test with recorded tool requests rather than a paid model

title: Agent workflows
outcome: Build a bounded agent loop with human oversight.
exercises: Draw allowed states and transitions including cancellation, denial and failure recovery.
Implement plan, act, observe with a stub model
Stop after a fixed step or cost budget
Pause side effects until approval is recorded
Resume from a persisted checkpoint after interruption without repeating a completed side effect.
Demonstrate refusal of an unauthorized action

title: LLM evaluation
outcome: Measure quality using a versioned evaluation set.
exercises: Define correctness, groundedness and usefulness separately
Create 30 representative questions with source evidence
Test schema, citations and refusal behavior
Score five answers with a written rubric
Categorize unsupported claims and missing evidence
Compare two configurations on identical examples

title: Security, latency and cost
outcome: Analyze practical risks in an AI application.
exercises: Insert malicious instructions into a retrieved document
Diagram data and instruction boundaries
Reject oversized and malformed requests
Measure retrieval and generation separately
Estimate per-request tokens and monthly usage
Verify tool permissions survive hostile content

title: HTTP and FastAPI
outcome: Build and test a documented JSON API.
exercises: Inspect methods, headers and status codes
Design resources for a task service including create, read, update, delete and error statuses.
Use typed request and response models
Return stable errors without exposing tracebacks
Test success, invalid input and missing records
Run the API and verify its generated schema

title: Databases and reliability
outcome: Persist user data with explicit ownership.
exercises: Create users, documents and jobs with foreign keys
Reject duplicate keys and invalid states
Test same-user and cross-user requests
Rollback a multi-step failure atomically
Make a retryable background operation idempotent
Simulate database unavailability and document recovery

title: Linux, Docker and CI
outcome: Make a reproducible deployment artifact.
exercises: Inspect process, port and filesystem permissions
Separate configuration from secrets and create an example environment file with no real credentials.
Build a minimal image with a non-root user
Connect an API and database locally through container networking and expose only intended ports.
Run lint and tests on a pull request
Tag a versioned image and document rollback without losing persistent database data.

title: Cloud and AI examination
outcome: Deploy and evaluate a research assistant.
exercises: Estimate usage against a free-tier limit
Keep secrets outside version control
Implement readiness and liveness checks
Attach a request ID without logging private documents
Alert on failure rate with a documented response
Present authenticated RAG with retrieval tests and cited answers

title: Observability
outcome: Trace a failing request across an AI system.
exercises: Write structured logs for one request
Propagate an ID across API and worker
Measure retrieval, model and database spans
Group repeated failures without sensitive payloads
Reproduce a seeded bug from telemetry
Write timeline, cause and prevention actions

title: Caching and security
outcome: Improve efficiency while preserving isolation.
exercises: Include user and version in private cache keys
Test stale content after document updates
Implement a token-bucket limiter and test burst capacity, refill timing and separate user quotas.
Set usage limits and visible error messages
Check access control and secret handling
Measure hit rate, latency and correctness together

title: Systems architecture
outcome: Explain a scalable AI application's tradeoffs.
exercises: Write functional and nonfunctional requirements
Separate ingestion, retrieval and inference responsibilities
Draw synchronous and asynchronous paths
Estimate requests, storage and token throughput
Identify bottlenecks before adding replicas
Compare two designs and justify the simpler sufficient one

title: Queues and reliability
outcome: Make asynchronous workflows recoverable.
exercises: Explain at-least-once delivery using a duplicate job
Deduplicate writes with a stable operation key
Bound retries and add jitter; simulate repeated failures and make the terminal error visible.
Record and inspect permanently failed jobs
Measure p50, p95 and error rate under load
Kill a worker and verify the job resumes safely

title: Fine-tuning datasets
outcome: Decide whether adaptation is justified.
exercises: Compare prompting, retrieval and fine-tuning for a use case
Record rights and consent for every data source
Author instruction-response pairs with clear quality criteria
Remove duplicates and private information
Split by source to avoid near-duplicate leakage
Set a baseline, compute budget and stopping criterion

title: LoRA and PEFT
outcome: Run or design a small parameter-efficient experiment.
exercises: Calculate trainable parameters for two ranks
Inspect target modules on a small open model
Estimate memory requirements before loading weights
Run a tiny local or free-notebook experiment
Compare base and adapted model on held-out prompts
Report quality, cost, limitations and reproducibility

title: Research reading
outcome: Extract claims and evidence from a paper.
exercises: Choose an accessible paper with public code
Separate claims from motivating statements
Explain the central algorithm in your own words
Identify baselines, datasets and ablations
List threats to validity and missing comparisons
Write a one-page summary with citations and open questions

title: Reproduction
outcome: Reproduce a bounded experimental claim.
exercises: Select one figure or table within your compute budget
Record versions, seeds and dataset checksums
Validate a minimal baseline on a tiny subset before using compute for the full experiment.
Repeat runs with at least three seeds and report mean and variation, not only the best result.
Compare errors with the paper's assumptions
Disclose deviations rather than claiming exact reproduction

title: Python interviews
outcome: Solve data-structure problems with clear reasoning.
exercises: Count operations and distinguish time from space
Solve two-sum and explain duplicate handling
Implement balanced-bracket validation
Reverse a linked list and test an empty list
Traverse a binary tree breadth-first and depth-first
Solve two unseen problems then review edge cases

title: Algorithms and SQL interviews
outcome: Choose algorithms and explain database queries.
exercises: Compare stability and complexity of common sorts
Find a lower bound with duplicates; test empty arrays, absent targets and boundary positions.
Write a recursive solution and identify its base case
Answer a grouped sales query with missing relationships
Find top records per group with a window function
Reproduce and repair an unfamiliar bug aloud

title: ML system design
outcome: Translate a product objective into a measurable ML system.
exercises: Define a useful prediction and its business metric
Specify labels, consent and freshness needs
Avoid training-serving skew in a feature design
Choose splits reflecting deployment conditions
Monitor drift without equating it with failure
Present a recommendation system and defend tradeoffs

title: AI interviews
outcome: Explain AI architecture and collaborate under uncertainty.
exercises: Design retrieval for a changing document collection
Explain permissions and approval boundaries
Compare hosted and local inference constraints
Tell a project story with measured evidence
Prepare situation, action and result examples
Record a mock session and identify three improvements

title: Capstone engineering
outcome: Close the highest-value gaps in a real workflow.
exercises: Interview a consenting user about one workflow
Rank issues by user impact and effort
Implement one coherent improvement from user feedback and demonstrate behavior before and after.
Test API, database and tool boundaries
Demonstrate recovery from a realistic failure
Freeze a candidate and write known limitations

title: Open source and writing
outcome: Contribute a reviewable change and explain your work.
exercises: Read contribution rules and choose a small issue
Create a minimal reproduction with expected behavior
Add a focused fix with meaningful tests
Respond constructively and revise the patch
Explain problem, design, evaluation and tradeoffs
Link commits, experiments and screenshots in a portfolio

title: Portfolio and recruitment
outcome: Present honest evidence of engineering competence.
exercises: Make three repositories runnable from clean setup
Record short demos including failure cases
Write outcome bullets without invented metrics
Map five real roles to required skills and connect every claimed skill to portfolio evidence.
Explain one project's hardest tradeoff in five minutes
Send tailored applications and record follow-up dates

title: Final review
outcome: Assess demonstrated skills and plan the next learning cycle.
exercises: Solve an unseen task with tests and explanation
Audit a model experiment for leakage and metric choice
Design a grounded, permission-aware assistant
Present user need, architecture, evidence and limitations
Identify skills supported by evidence and remaining gaps
Choose three measurable goals based on actual results
